author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.24.0 — Two real bugs found from live logs: (1) a room exiting via mode 11 ('docked, cleaning will resume') was being credited as finished immediately, even though the vacuum genuinely auto-resumed the same job later -- confirmed live (a 9-minute credit when the real total was 34 minutes across two segments). Now leaves the run active and carries elapsed time forward until it actually, genuinely finishes. (2) Adds stuck detection: if the vacuum reports idle-and-not-charging for 30+ minutes, you get a push notification, since a healthy vacuum is always cleaning, returning to charge, or charging -- confirmed live via a 7-hour stuck episode that drained the battery with no alert.
